templates: Exact same aligned templates and demonstrations in all arms; demonstrations use the same serializer as the final request.
budget: Common worker uses absolute 384-new-token budget in every format, 4096 total tokens, greedy decoding, four threads, ten-second request deadline. This differs from historical proportional-budget runs; only within-experiment comparisons are paired.
selection: Inspect every dev output before freezing a non-XML candidate; prioritize full fidelity, no harmful context changes, supported repairs and natural organization. Failure does not authorize promotion.
references: Evaluator-only. All source/context bytes, assigned/effective scenes, actual prompt version, raw/cleanup/delivered results retained.
scope: Chinese text-only macOS development diagnostic. Bilingual, natural ASR/OCR, native lifecycle and independent review remain release requirements.
